evidence: Different W ﬁlms of 1300 Å marked A, B, C and D were deposited on a settled material stack as shown in Fig. 1. It is worth noting that the settled material stack mimics the HKMG stack in our real p-type devices. All W ﬁlms were deposited in AMAT Centura iSPIRIT tungsten WxZ chambers. A is traditional W deposited by CVD with SiH4 & WF6, B is B2H6-based ALD W, C is SiH4-based ALD W and D is B2H6-based ALD W with prior SiH4 treatment.
